Disclaimer_Body: PCEdit edits Planet Crafter save files directly, and a bad edit can corrupt a save and lose progress. PCEdit copies your save aside before it first writes to it, but treat that as a safety net rather than a substitute: keep your own backup as well. This software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
Disclaimer_ShortNotice: Editing can corrupt a save. Back up your file first — use at your own risk.

About_SaveLocationsNote: Xbox names each save with a random string that changes every time it is written. On Linux, replace ~/.steam/steam with your Steam library folder if the game lives on another drive.
